usage: A webpage is a digital document accessible through the internet.
網頁 is used to refer to individual pages on a website.
You can say '我瀏覽咗個網頁' to mean 'I browsed a webpage.'
網頁 can be combined with other words like 網頁設計 (webpage design) or 網頁內容 (webpage content).
In a sentence, 網頁 usually functions as the object or the subject.
